sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:53

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:53:1
items.html:
Male and Nukva in Partzufim separate from one another, etc.; they are not joined except when they are back to back: For when they are in Katnut, which means that there is no illumination of Hochma in them, this deficiency is revealed chiefly in the NHY of ZA, since there is the place of the revelation of the illumination of Hochma, and there is fear lest the shells suck from the posterior of NHY. For in any place where there is some deficiency in holiness, the shells attach there and suck from the flaw. Therefore they have a correction at that time: to receive the light of the posterior of the upper Ima, from the side of her screen, which repels Hochma, because He desires mercy; for Bina desires Hassadim more than Hochma, since such is the nature of her GAR, from the force of the Bina of the direct light, as is known. And therefore, at the time when ZON receive the light of Bina from the discernment of her GAR, her aforementioned posterior is influenced to them, and the deficiency of Hochma in them is filled from the force of the GAR of Bina. And these posterior that they receive are called by the name “wall,” meaning a screen that detains the illumination of Hochma.
Then it is regarded that ZA and his Nukva are attached to one another by that wall, since in every place where the posterior of the upper Ima expand, NHY are found included in HGT, and they cannot be revealed outward, as is known. And since the NHY of ZA are the root of the Nukva, it is found that the Nukva is attached to ZA and included in him, and she has no revelation outward.
And this is what he says: “For then their posteriors are stuck together, and one wall serves them both, and a sawing off at the back is required to separate them,” for that wall which they received from the posterior of Ima attaches them to one another, because it does not allow the NHY to expand outward, since the posterior of Ima has control only in the GAR of ZON, which are HGT. For even in Bina herself her posterior was cut off from her ZAT, as is known from the secret of the Bina of the direct light: when she came to emanate ZON, she was forced to cut off her posterior and return face to face with Hochma, in order to bestow the illumination of Hochma to her ZON. Therefore, also in ZA himself, she cannot bestow her posterior except in his GAR, which are HGT; and hence NHY are found included in HGT, in the secret of “and their backs were toward the house,” as is known.
And this is what he says: “And a sawing off at the back is required to separate them.” That is, it is impossible for the Nukva to be revealed outward and come out of the inclusion of HGT, except by the sawing off of the posterior of the upper Ima from them. However, these posterior are not sawed off except by the raising of MAN to AVI; for then Ima herself also cuts off her posterior and returns face to face with the upper Aba, and the HG that come out in AVI by this coupling of theirs descend and are influenced to ZON; and by these HG the posterior of ZON are also cut off and sawed off. Then the NHY are revealed outward and separate from HGT; and also the Nukva of ZA, who is herself the discernment of these NHY that are revealed outward, is found separated from ZA, and she becomes a Partzuf of her own. And this is what is said in the Zohar: “Hesed came and separated them,” for the HG that descend from the face-to-face coupling of AVI descend and come to ZON, and through them they are sawed off and separated from one another, and become two distinct Partzufim. And it has been explained that the posterior cannot be sawed off from ZON before the upper Ima herself cuts off her posterior in her own place. It was also explained that the main virtue of ZON is only when they are separate Partzufim, for then they are in Gadlut, and can couple face to face. But when the wall of the posterior rules over them, they are attached to one another by that wall, and there is no coupling between them then, for she is included in him.
